# Brian Marshall

> Business Systems Architect for owner-operated businesses with real revenue and broken backends. Free 15-minute qualifying call, then the $1,500 AOF Master Audit maps operations in 13 blocks before anything gets built. Implementation covers CRM, automation, AI, integrations, and funnels.

Brian Marshall (brian@areoclient.com) is founder of AreoClient. Primary audience: owner-operated businesses generating real revenue that have outgrown manual operations. Secondary resources target coaches packaging expertise into offers.

## Primary funnel

- [Home](https://brianmarshall.dev/): Positioning, problem, AOF teaser, process, economics, case studies, FAQ, contact
- [AOF Master Audit](https://brianmarshall.dev/aof): Full 13-block framework, stress-test scenarios, sample audit preview, self-audit quiz, paid booking at purchase section ($1,500)
- [Reserve AOF session](https://brianmarshall.dev/aof#purchase): GHL paid booking calendar for the Master Audit
- [Free qualifying call](https://brianmarshall.dev/calendar): 15-minute call, no pitch, optional pre-call qualifier
